children: Evernorth reported net income for the quarter, compared with a net loss from inception through September 30, 2025. The current-period result primarily reflected a $162.8M gain from changes in fair value of refundable investor advances, partly offset by $6.9M of digital asset impairment and $666,834 of general and administrative expenses.
: The company held approximately 346.3 million XRP as of September 30, 2026.
: The company recorded $6.9M of impairment in the quarter.
: The merger closed October 9, 2026; the shares began trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12.
: Evernorth issued $30.0M of convertible notes on October 13 and received $29.0M in net cash proceeds.
